claims.statement: Nuclear DNA is copied in S phase; mitosis partitions chromosomes and cytokinesis separates daughter cells. Cell-cycle duration is not automatically the population doubling time.
limitations: No universal duration or synchronization is inferred.

claims.statement: DNA replication copies the genome before division; it is not the creation of a new organ.
limitations: No error rate or repair treatment is specified.

claims.statement: Culture vessels are housed in controlled culture equipment; microscopy is used for observation. Primary-cell comparisons are sensitive to donor and culture differences.
claims.locator: Primary cell culture introduction; Challenges; endothelial culture and microscopy sections
limitations: Conceptual equipment mapping only. No handling instructions or equipment settings.

claims.statement: The Figure 4 caption reports BM-MSC population doubling times across compared conditions of about 22–46 hours, excluding one formulation; Results include different P4–P5 summaries.
claims.locator: Figure 4 caption; Results: growth kinetics; Discussion
limitations: Study-specific comparison, not a universal interval, confidence interval or schedule. Distinct endpoints must not be pooled.

claims.statement: The studied human iPS and hES cultures showed an approximately 16–18-hour cell cycle, measured between successive S phases.
claims.locator: Results: Reprogrammed Pluripotent Cells Have an Abbreviated Cell Cycle of 16–18 Hours; Figure 6
limitations: Cell-cycle observation, not population doubling or a duration for differentiated derivatives.

claims.statement: The studied primary dermal fibroblast culture slowed to a replicative-senescence plateau.
claims.locator: Results: Primary human fibroblasts grown across the cellular lifespan; Figure 1b
limitations: A specified donor culture; no universal fibroblast lifespan or indefinite expansion is inferred.

claims.statement: Nucleosides added to culture medium reduced replication stress, genome-damage markers and mitotic aberrations in the studied human PSC cultures.
limitations: Not a generic coating or repair recipe. No demonstrated reversal of existing mutations, removal of mutant clones, cancer prevention or graft-safety guarantee.

claims.statement: TP53-mutant subpopulations expanded across passages in the studied hESC cultures; the broader screen also included hiPSC lines.
limitations: Selection is different from counting replication events. Not every line had detectable mutations; no cancer probability is computed.

claims.modelContext: human periportal liver assembloids in vitro
claims.statement: The work assembled human periportal liver tissue models containing hepatocyte and cholangiocyte compartments with portal fibroblasts, not a complete liver.
limitations: Human in-vitro model and reported mouse experiments are different endpoints. No whole-liver production duration is established.

claims.modelContext: scope limitations of a periportal assembloid
claims.statement: The Discussion identifies absent immune/other mesenchymal populations and portal vasculature as limitations.
limitations: No generic endothelial or stromal population is automatically equivalent to its liver-specific counterpart.
